feral_kin.conceptNotes: Tripo agent claim withdrawn 2026-09-26: typing the concept prompt into Tripo's image generator was blocked by the permission system, so no feral_kin concepts were made. Race is free for the concept agent.

settings.building: image-to-3D HD Model H3.1 Best Quality, Ultra Mesh Quality, 4K PBR texture, Remove Lighting, triangle topology 50,000 faces: 55 credits
settings.builder: same as building but 8K texture (65) + Humanoid auto-rig UE5 Mannequin preset (20); preset clips free, text-to-motion 20/clip

plan.scope: 110 L1 meshes (99 buildings + 9 builders + 2 obelisks) + 99 final-form meshes = 209 Tripo generations; 198 L2/L3 texture tiers

perModel.builder: 65 (8K) + 20 rig + up to 20 for a text-to-motion work clip = 105

plan.textureTiers: Tripo texture-only regen costs 20 per variant at 4K (30 at 8K): 198 x 20 = 3960, which does not fit after the meshes. L2/L3 go to a headless Blender material pass (free, identical geometry).
